_readme: Review queue for the identified-project tracker. Entries are UNVERIFIED leads from a news/registry scan and are never published. To promote one: read the governing body's own agenda or the reporting, add a record to data/projects.json with source + as_of (and any known milestone dates), then set this entry's status to 'promoted'. To reject one, set status to 'dismissed' — the scanner will not raise it again. `link` is the dedup key and must be unique per entry; a hand-added lead that cites an index page needs a distinct #fragment.
